Every relation MUST include an evidence field. Before returning, verify all entities have all four required keys: id, name, type, evidence. Omit unsupported items. Use empty lists when appropriate. Return compact JSON without indentation. Do not repeat entities or relations. Do not create generic category nodes such as hotel or person merely to express an entity type.
